phases.label: Delivery blocks the aisle
phases.arrival_feedback: A delivery dolly waits beside mismarked cartons while the front-door lane remains visibly open.
phases.exit_prompt: The marked front-door lane is still clear if you leave the delivery alone.

interaction.label: Marked front-door lane
interaction.prompt: Ignore the cartons, refuse the request, or leave through the clear lane.

interaction.label: Damaged delivery manifest
interaction.prompt: Inspect the damaged manifest before shifting any cartons.

inputs.message: The damaged manifest identifies which cartons must move before the stock choice can be opened.

interaction_ops.disabled_reason: Inspect and sort the delivery before resolving its stock choice.

transition_ops.message: The delivery clerk wheels mismarked cartons across the aisle while keeping the marked front-door lane open.
transition_ops.reduced_motion_message: The delivery cartons are now beside the open front-door lane.

phases.label: Reroute the delivery
phases.arrival_feedback: The clerk shifts the dolly aside, exposing the damaged label and a route for the mismarked cartons.
phases.exit_prompt: Ignore or refuse the delivery at the marked front-door lane while sorting begins.

interaction.label: Mismarked cartons
interaction.prompt: Roll the mismarked cartons toward the open sorting station.

transition_ops.message: The cartons shift out of the center aisle and the clerk marks a safe route toward the sorting station.

phases.label: Verify the mismarked lot
phases.arrival_feedback: A cleared shelf and the damaged label form a physical verification station beside the rerouted cartons.
phases.exit_prompt: The marked front-door lane remains open beside the verification shelf.

interaction.label: Delivery verification shelf
interaction.prompt: Open the existing delivery-stock choice to verify this lot.

transition_ops.message: The rerouted cartons, damaged label, and manifest now meet at one readable verification station.

phases.label: Await the stock decision
phases.arrival_feedback: The verification request is open; the clerk shifts beside the damaged carton while the legacy stock choice remains unresolved.
phases.exit_prompt: Ignore, refuse, or leave through the marked front-door lane while the stock decision is pending.

interaction_ops.disabled_reason: The delivered scenario request owns this stock choice; the base card stays gated.

transition_ops.message: The verification shelf goes quiet while the correlated stock choice is delivered.
transition_ops.reduced_motion_message: The clerk and cartons now wait beside the open manifest.

phases.label: The delivery changes the store
phases.arrival_feedback: The delivery choice resolves into a persistent shelf, clerk, service, and route arrangement.
phases.exit_prompt: The marked front-door lane remains the clean exit in every delivery outcome.

interaction_ops.disabled_reason: The delivery-stock choice is no longer independently available.

transition_ops.message: The delivery decision is now visible in the store and ready for revisit.

steps.label: Reroute the cartons to the verification shelf

operations.disabled_reason: This delivery can no longer open independent stock consequences.

repaired.label: Rack stocked and sorted
repaired.revisit_feedback: The stocked rack is orderly, Ada is relieved, the cashier tip remains enabled, and the jazz-club route is open.

broken.label: Torn carton remains
broken.revisit_feedback: A torn carton remains after Priya departs; the cashier tip is disabled and the bar route is closed.

object.label: Cashier delivery tip
object.disabled_reason: Ada is documenting the crushed delivery instead of pricing an exit tip.

route_ops.disabled_reason: The damaged delivery blocks the route toward the bar.

refused.label: Delivery refused
refused.revisit_feedback: A sealed pallet remains under Ada's watch; the cashier tip is disabled and the pawn-shop route is closed.

object.label: Cashier delivery tip
object.disabled_reason: Ada is handling the return paperwork and will not sell the delivery tip.

route_ops.disabled_reason: The return pickup occupies the pawn-shop route.

interrupted.label: Delivery interrupted
interrupted.revisit_feedback: An abandoned manifest remains after Priya departs; the cashier tip stays enabled and the gas-station casino route is closed.

route_ops.disabled_reason: The interrupted unloading closes the casino route for this visit.

inputs.message: The clerk records the correlated manifest choice before sorting continues.
Leaving interrupts the delivery and preserves an abandoned-manifest aftermath.

authoring.arrival_summary: A delivery dolly, mismarked cartons, and a damaged label create a readable sorting task without covering the front-door lane.
